# Parameter
```{r}
# =========================
# Parameter
# =========================


high_line  <- "#D97742"
# mid_line  <- "#5D9C59"
low_line <- "#4F81BD"

high_fill  <- "#F3B082"
low_fill <- "#9DC3E6"

# ---------- half-eye / raincloud ----------
violin_width <- 0.7
violin_linewidth <- 2
violin_alpha <- 0.2

density_adjust <- 1
density_trim <- FALSE
scale <- 0.45

point_x_offset <- 0.06

jitter_width <- 0.08
jitter_size <- 6
jitter_alpha <- 0.45

mean_point_size <- 12
mean_errorbar_width <- 0.15
mean_errorbar_linewidth <- 4

reg_linewidth <- 4

sig_y <- 40
# sig_size <- 42

sig_size_plus <- 22   # +
sig_size_star <- 30   # *
sig_size_ns   <- 22   # ns（如果保留的话）

# Vertical offset
sig_offset_plus  <- 0.4
sig_offset_star  <- 0
sig_offset_ns    <- 0
```


# Allocation

```{r}

data_dir <- paste0(file.path("..", "figs_data"), .Platform$file.sep)
data_path <- paste0(data_dir, 'EXP2-2_CMPD_Uncertain-to-Certain_widedata_260128.xlsx')

situation_levels <- c("Uncertain46", "Uncertain37", "Uncertain28")
situation_labels <- c("U46", "U37", "U28")

df <- read_excel(data_path, sheet = "Allocation") %>%
  mutate(
    Situation = factor(Situation, levels = situation_levels),
    Situation_num = as.numeric(Situation)
  )

```

```{r}
data_dir <- paste0(file.path("..", "figs_data"), .Platform$file.sep)
data_path <- paste0(data_dir, '04_1_var_differ_byPE_EXP2-2_CMPD_260714.xlsx')

situation_levels <- c("Uncertain46", "Uncertain37", "Uncertain28")
situation_labels <- c("U46", "U37", "U28")

df <- read_excel(data_path, sheet = "Sheet2") %>%
  mutate(
    Situation = factor(Situation, levels = situation_levels),
    Situation_num = as.numeric(Situation)
  )

MANOVA(
  df, dv = "var_abs", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome","Situation"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Situation", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", by = "Situation", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Situation", by = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni")

```

```{r regression}


# =========================
# Overall t-test
# =========================
t_test <- t.test(df$var_abs_diff, mu = 0)
d_result <- cohens_d(t_test)

print(t_test)
print(d_result)

# =========================
# One-sample t-test by Situation
# =========================

ttest_res <- df %>%
  group_by(Situation, Situation_num) %>%
  summarize(
    test = list(tidy(t.test(var_abs_diff, mu = 0))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(test) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.value,
    # p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),

    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      p_adj < 0.10  ~ "†",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    sig_size = case_when(
      sig == "†"   ~ sig_size_plus,
      sig == "*"   ~ sig_size_star,
      sig == "**"  ~ sig_size_star,
      sig == "***" ~ sig_size_star,
      TRUE         ~ sig_size_ns
    ),
    
    sig_y_plot = sig_y + case_when(
      sig == "†"   ~ sig_offset_plus,
      sig == "*"   ~ sig_offset_star,
      sig == "**"  ~ sig_offset_star,
      sig == "***" ~ sig_offset_star,
      TRUE         ~ sig_offset_ns
    )
  )
  
ttest_res

```

```{r regression}

# =========================
# Long data
# =========================
plot_data <- df %>%
  select(Situation, Situation_num, high_var_abs, low_var_abs) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(high_var_abs, low_var_abs),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = recode(
      Group,
      high_var_abs = "High",
      low_var_abs = "Low"
    ),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Low", "High")),
    x_pos = case_when(
      Group == "Low"  ~ Situation_num - point_x_offset,
      Group == "High" ~ Situation_num + point_x_offset
    )
  )

# =========================
# Regression results
# =========================
lm_high <- lm(high_var_abs ~ Situation_num, data = df)
lm_low <- lm(low_var_abs ~ Situation_num, data = df)

high_summary <- summary(lm_high)
low_summary <- summary(lm_low)

reg_results <- data.frame(
  Group = c("High", "Low"),
  Intercept = c(coef(lm_high)[1], coef(lm_low)[1]),
  Slope = c(coef(lm_high)[2], coef(lm_low)[2]),
  R_squared = c(high_summary$r.squared, low_summary$r.squared),
  P_value = c(
    coef(high_summary)["Situation_num", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    coef(low_summary)["Situation_num", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
)

summary(lm_high)
summary(lm_low)
reg_results

# =========================
# Mean ± SE
# =========================
summary_long <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Situation, Situation_num, Group, x_pos) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_long

```


## fig-Allocation
```{r}
# =========================
# Figure: Vertical raincloud + mean ± SE + regression
# =========================

output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\02_exp5_var_diff_CMPD_260613.svg"

p <- ggplot() +

  # Regression lines
  geom_smooth(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = Value,
      color = Group,
      group = Group
    ),
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = reg_linewidth,
    alpha = 1
  ) +

  # ---------- Outcome2: left half-eye ----------
  stat_halfeye(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(Group == "Low"),
    aes(
      x = Situation_num - point_x_offset,
      y = Value,
      fill = Group
    ),
    fill = scales::alpha(low_fill, violin_alpha),
    slab_color = low_line,
    slab_linewidth = violin_linewidth,
    orientation = "vertical",
    side = "left",
    adjust = density_adjust,
    trim = density_trim,
    width = violin_width,
    scale = scale,
    .width = 0,
    point_interval = NULL
  ) +
  # # High
  # stat_halfeye(
  #   data = plot_data %>% filter(Group == "High"),
  #   aes(
  #     x = Situation_num + point_x_offset,
  #     y = Value,
  #     fill = Group
  #   ),
  #   side = "right",
  #   adjust = 1,
  #   width = violin_width,
  #   slab_alpha = violin_alpha,
  #   .width = 0,
  #   point_interval = NULL,
  #   color = NA
  # ) +
  stat_halfeye(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(Group == "High"),
    aes(
      x = Situation_num + point_x_offset,
      y = Value,
      fill = Group
    ),
    fill = scales::alpha(high_fill, violin_alpha),
    slab_color = high_line,
    slab_linewidth = violin_linewidth,
    orientation = "vertical",
    side = "right",
    adjust = density_adjust,
    trim = density_trim,
    width = violin_width,
    scale = scale,
    .width = 0,
    point_interval = NULL
  ) +

  # Mean ± SE
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_long,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se,
      color = Group
    ),
    width = mean_errorbar_width,
    linewidth = mean_errorbar_linewidth
  ) +
  
  # Mean diamond
  geom_point(
    data = summary_long,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = mean_value,
      fill = Group
    ),
    shape = 23,
    size = mean_point_size,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 3
  ) +

  # Significance labels
  geom_text(
    data = ttest_res,
    aes(
      x = Situation_num,
      y = sig_y_plot,
      label = sig,
      size = sig_size
    ),
    color = "black",
    
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      Low = low_fill,
      High = high_fill
    )
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      Low = low_line,
      High = high_line
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 45),
    breaks = seq(0, 40, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.0)),
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2, 3),
    labels = situation_labels,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0.5, 3.5),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Situation",
    y = "|ΔAllocation|"
  ) +

  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()

```

  Group = c("High", "Low"),
  Intercept = c(high_coef[1], low_coef[1]),
  Slope = c(high_coef[2], low_coef[2]),
  R_squared = c(high_r2, low_r2),
  P_value = c(high_p, low_p)
)

print("回归结果:")

               shape = 23, size = 6, fill = "#F5C542", position = position_nudge(x = -0.05)) +
  stat_summary(data = df, aes(x = as.numeric(Situation), y = high_var_abs, group = Situation), fun = mean, geom = "point",
